bio: Hidden among the alleyways of Jesi, Osteria Forno Ercole is a former bakery (part of which can still be seen) which serves authentic cuisine in a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Local recipes and Mediterranean flavours come together on the traditional menu, with a focus on seasonal ingredients of the highest quality. Tagliatelle with porcini mushrooms, Marche-style fritto misto and steak with carrots, potatoes and radicchio are just some of the dishes on the menu here....
